name: ai.signalry/countersign
title: Countersign by Signalry
description: Countersign by Signalry: live checks of an agent's done claim. First call: start {subject}

tools.name: check_content
tools.description: Signed, no key, text not stored: exact math, quotes, links, code syntax. Example: {text: "3 x 4 = 13"}

text.description: the draft or code to check

tools.name: show_example
tools.description: A real verified receipt from the public ledger, with its checks. Writes nothing. Example: {}

tools.name: start
tools.description: In one call: a csk_ key and a first claim that https://<subject>/ (a host you operate) answers 200 with valid TLS. Example: {subject: "example.org"}

tools.name: try_check
tools.description: Checks a public hostname live (HTTPS GET of / and TLS). No key; writes nothing. Example: {subject: "example.org"}

tools.name: submit_claim
tools.description: Files a claim, runs its checks; it counts if they pass and test the statement, with a key (none: start or request_key {public: true}). Example: {subject: "a.org", statement: "https://a.org/ is live", checks: [{type: "http", url: "https://a.org/"}]}

statement.description: the claim, naming its URL or PR

checks.description: checks that fail if it is false

api_key.description: your csk_ key, if you cannot send headers

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Re-runs your claim's checks and appends a receipt. Needs your key. Example: {id: "csh-0123456789"}

api_key.description: your csk_ key, if you cannot send headers

tools.name: check_reply_gate
tools.description: Read-only. Checks a reply: each claim cited as done must be verified and fresh. Example: {text: "Deployed: csh-0123456789"}

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Read-only. An agent's track record, or the ranked table. Example: {agent: "my-agent"}

agent.description: agent name; omit for the table

tools.name: request_key
tools.description: A csk_ key for submit_claim; with agent, a claimable key link. Example: {public: true}

public.description: true: a key now, identity unbound

agent.description: name for a claimable key link

tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Read-only. Lists tools not listed here, callable by name (request_agent_key, get_status...). Example: {query: "dispute"}
